authoring: skill text is authored directly in this repo; a server-side publish pipeline takes over at ship time. `skills` is the roster `npx skills add moda-design/moda` installs, and the set `moda doctor` compares an install against to decide `checks.skills.ok` — hand-written like setup's SKILLS line, and pinned to skills/ by scripts/export-mirror.py so it cannot drift.

cli.note: moda doctor reads this file's range when a skill runs Step 0: below the floor it stops the skill and prints the pinned upgrade command.
